nectivity. An interactive OAuth flow is unnecessary with this supplied credential.

e.” The local MCPJam CLI provides the direct validation fallback. These responses are retained in `requests.jsonl`; they do not es

saves doctor, conformance, and arithmetic evidence. It requires Node/npm, Python 3, and package registry access. No credential is
embedded in the scripts or reports.
